purpose: Dedicated Village and Imperial Envoy engine challenge against the frozen Collection–Swindler rush
uncertainty_method: Normal approximation to the mean seat-pair score, using sample variance across independently seeded pairs; ties count as half. Descriptive intervals for frozen finalists, not an exhaustive optimality guarantee.
limitations: Bounded, manually designed policy families, not exhaustive strategy optimization.
Both finalists chosen using confirmation performance against the frozen rush; validation was not used to retune.
No new exhaustive endgame search or optimized Sleigh/Hill Fort plan.
Printed acquisition caps do not guarantee that every game reaches those caps.
